lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: ... and now for our next story.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: A Nikke escaped from the facility last weekend, resulting in an accident in which 10 citizens were killed and 21 injured.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: Although the perpetrator was brought to justice, the subsequent public outcry has yet to subside.

lines.speaker: citizen
lines.text: This isn't the first time this has happened. How can I step outside and feel safe when things like this are a regular occurrence?

lines.speaker: citizen
lines.text: If this keeps up, we'd be better off sending all those damn machines to the scrapyard!

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: Citizens have also voiced their concerns over whether Enikk will find the facility manager guilty of dereliction of duty or manslaughter.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Pfffff...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Pffaahh... hahaha!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Sure enough, no one has the slightest idea that I was involved! What a bunch of morons.
What's going on?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: It's very simple. The Association covered up my traces.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Even the most loyal lap dogs for The Big O will have a hard time picking up my scent.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: But it's not just that... it's nice to let urban legends keep their mystique, don't you think?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: If the other Nikkes knew they were fighting shoulder to shoulder with someone who could be sent to kill them one day...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: they'd never rest easy.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Sigh... such is the lonely fate to which I am resigned.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: However, there is someone else who knows this feeling all too well. The Guardian of Balance...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: El Telema Solus.
I wonder
what's going on in that head of yours...
What are you staring me down for?
It must be lonely.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I'm not staring!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: ... yes, it is.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Very much so.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: That's not why I came here.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Can you guess why I'm here today?
No.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Sigh... Fine, I'll explain it again.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Back when we were dealing with that rogue Nikke, I sensed something in you.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: A shred of disobedience towards The Big O, or should I say... the seeds of revolution?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: So I put forward a proposal to The Association, and it's decided. You're qualified to be one of us.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: The Association will respect your decision.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: So... what do you think?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Do you want to become a member of the Golden Cross? That's our association.
What kind of name is that?
Got it.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I should have known.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: A plebian like yourself couldn't possibly grasp the greatness of this name.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Is it really that bad?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: We can change it if you want.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hexagonal Daredevil Group, Ark Mystery Association... something like that.
The original name is better.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: All right, Golden Cross it is.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Actually, this name is my favorite.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: So? How about it?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Do you want to be one of [us]?
Yes.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: No kidding! That's not what I expected.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You didn't even think about it. Why?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I thought you'd find some way to weasel your way out of agreeing to it.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Or that you'd go red in the face and hum and haw.
If anyone's going to blush, it'll be you.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I won't even dignify that with a response.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Now answer my question.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Why did you agree so easily?
You don't have to bear all this pain alone. I want to help.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: My... pain?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Pssh, I don't know what you're talking about.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Ever since I sealed away the Devil Prince, I've numbed myself to all this pain and hardship you humans call life.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Believe me, I'm doing just fine.
I saw the sadness in your face when you executed that Nikke.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Ha.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: OK, I admit it.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Sometimes, it's all a tough pill to swallow.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: But I can manage.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I am Guillotine de Mephisto.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I am the Guardian of Balance who will one day liberate the Ark from The Big O!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: The keeper of the One-Winged Dark Lord!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Such trivialities would never get me down!
You don't need to pretend to be strong in front of me.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You... you can see right through people.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You have such perceptive eyes.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Eyes that could pull someone out of the quagmire.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: ... I ought to call them the Super Eyeballs of Truth!
... Talk about spoiling the mood.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hehe, sorry.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Anyway, I'm glad you feel that way.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: If you've made up your mind, then we shouldn't drag our feet.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I hereby exercise my authority as Guillotine de Mephisto

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: and will hold a ceremony in commemoration of your joining the Golden Cross.
A ceremony? Is that really necessary?
Got it.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Don't you know anything? During the ceremony, members come to me...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: No, what I mean is...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Holding a ceremony to accept members is an indispensable part of how we do things in The Association. It's important for maintaining a sense of unity.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: It's not something that can be overlooked.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Let me go over the steps with you.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: So let me explain the steps first.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You know about knighting ceremonies in the medieval ages? It's more-or-less the same thing.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: First, you must kneel before me.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I will take my favorite weapon and tap it upon both of your shoulders.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Firearms are my weapon of choice, which are a bit heavy, but I'm sure you can handle them.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Finally,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: to pledge your loyalty, you will kiss the back of my hand... and that's all.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: After that, you will become my Servant.
Why do I have to be a Servant?
Did you say kiss?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Yes, a Servant.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I shall be your master. You will be my shadow, following me wherever I go and obeying me without question.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: If it helps, think of it as respecting your elders.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: What you must do is help me uncover the secret of The Big O.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Also, once a week, when my right eye is giving me pain,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: you are to buy me desserts so that I'll feel better.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Yes, kiss.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: What, you never heard of kissing before?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: That's not like you.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You're surrounded by beautiful women constantly and you always keep your cool.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: If The Big O knew your knees were quaking at something this innocuous...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: No, this won't do. Keep that buried deep down.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Now, where were we?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: After the ceremony, you, as my Servant, will be in my service for 5 years.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: As your master, I will assure The Association of your loyalty.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You will then become a full member of The Association.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: That's about it. Got all that?
Yes.
Yes, Master.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Okay then, let's get to it.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Very good! Let's get to it.
... Soon after.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: As a member of Golden Cross,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: your faith must remain unshaken, and you must be unyielding in the face of injustice.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Do you swear to serve your the master, who will lead you to the truth, in all piety?
I swear.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Very good. Then I, as the Guardian of Balance,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: take you as both a reserve member of Golden Cross and as my servant.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Finally, you must impress a brand of dedication upon your master.
You kiss the back of Guillotine's hand.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: ... Well. Ahem.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: This marks the end of the ceremony.
You're blushing.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Ah... Erm... That's because of the ceremony, yes!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: A side effect of excessive magic use. Yes, that's a good enough excuse.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: ... Why did I go and say that...?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: It's just a kiss on the back of the hand!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I've seen it all the time in all these kinds of ceremonies, so I thought I would give it a try.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: What is this wonderful feeling?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Could it be... the machinations of The Big O meant to hinder the ceremony?
I don't think so.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Um...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: are you all right?
What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Uh, well,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I mean.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Pfffff...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Pffaahh... hahaha!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: All right, all right, let's move on!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I'm the Guardian of Balance for goodness' sake! I keep a safe distance from all earthly affairs.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: How could a mere kiss on the back of the hand have me swooning like this!
Aha.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Um... Well... anyway...
Guillotine takes out her phone.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: ... It's me.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I have a target that we'll have to eliminate in due time. {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: He knows too much about me. We cannot allow him to leave.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: It also appears that in order to protect this individual, The Big O has secretly injected me with drugs that are causing my heart rate to increase rapidly...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: C'mon, can't you just let me be happy for a minute here?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hello, Codename Jarhead...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: No, Ingrid! Listen to me. Don't do that...!
She hangs up the phone.
You're blushing again.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You are so annoying!
